empty.title: Your collection is empty
empty.subtitle: Add your first perfume with the + button

form.name: Name
form.ratingHint: Click = half star, double click = full star

hints.brand: Perfume house or brand. E.g.: Dior, Chanel, Tom Ford.
hints.name: Full perfume name as it appears on the bottle.
hints.concentration: Concentration type: Eau de Toilette, Eau de Parfum, Parfum, Extrait, etc.
hints.family: Main olfactory family. E.g.: Woody, Floral, Oriental, Fresh, Aromatic.
hints.moment: Select when you prefer to wear this perfume. You can choose both.
hints.season: Ideal seasons for this perfume. You can select multiple.
hints.price: Price paid for the perfume. Leave at 0 if it was a gift.
hints.rating: Your personal rating from 0.5 to 10. Click = half star, double click = full star.
hints.image: URL of a perfume image. You can copy it from any website.
hints.perfumer: Type the perfumer's name and press + to add. You can add multiple.
hints.accords: Type an accord and press + to add it. E.g.: Woody.
hints.notes: Type a note and press + to add it. E.g.: Bergamot.
